The internal contradiction is a fatal logical flaw, making response b inferior in logical coherence.

coherence_stylistic.explantion: Both Response a and Response b were judged to have a consistent formal academic tone, uniform lexical complexity, and maintain a third‑person objective voice throughout, with no reported stylistic inconsistencies.
